item.title: Chimpanzees have thrown rocks at same trees for over a decade
item.description: Some West African chimpanzees repeatedly throw rocks at specific trees, creating stone piles that persist for more than ten years. Researchers continue to study this behavior.

item.title: All 212 plant-based meat alternatives tested contained fungal toxins
item.description: A UK study found that every one of 212 plant-based meat alternatives and drinks contained at least one naturally occurring fungal toxin, though levels varied.

item.title: Study of 4,500 animals reveals human presence shapes wildlife movement
item.description: Tracking thousands of animals, researchers found that human presence can alter wildlife movement and habitats, sometimes as much as roads or other infrastructure.

item.title: NASA's Roman telescope to survey 100 times more sky than Hubble
item.description: The Roman Space Telescope will offer Hubble-like resolution across a field of view 100 times larger, enabling broad new astronomical surveys.
